pages.text: The Spirit Drive is non-stacking. Use an unbound drive in the air to claim it; its tooltip shows the latest owner name. A valid legacy session UUID migrates in place to the persistent ImmortalStorage identity without clearing item data, and another player cannot force a rebind.

The drive is a reusable fuel credential, not consumable fuel. In a vanilla furnace or ImmortalStorage machine, it charges one Immortal Yuan from its online owner's personal storage, then one True Yuan if needed. With no available balance, the machine waits and retries.

Immortal Furnaces, Simulated Reincarnation Furnaces, and Simulated Spirit Fields accept the drive. Machine contents, outputs, and the drive itself remain intact across launcher changes. Ownership shares the same persistent identity as personal realms, storage media, interfaces, and Substitute Puppets.
